## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The containment check in `preview` has to be fixed before merge. It compares paths by their text only, so a `..` segment still lets a caller read files outside the home directory.

## Changes
The pull request adds `preview(home, relative)`, which returns the first 200 characters of a file after checking that the file is under `home`. It also adds `settings_file(home)`, along with tests for both helpers and a new `tests/review-note.txt` file.

## Critical
- app/paths.py:12 — correctness — Resolve paths before the containment check in preview — When `preview(home, "../etc/passwd")` is called, the function reads a file outside `home` and returns its contents. `Path.is_relative_to` only compares the text of the path parts, so `home/../etc/passwd` still starts with `home` and passes the check. Symlinks inside `home` that point elsewhere also pass. — Any caller that passes a user-supplied relative path can read arbitrary files the process can access. — Fix: Compare resolved paths with `Path(home, relative).resolve().is_relative_to(Path(home).resolve())`, and extend `test_preview` with a `"../outside.txt"` case.
